name: vega-physiotherapy-app
description: Vega Physiotherapy — React frontend + Express API (production-ready)

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"

scripts.start: node init && npm run start --prefix server
scripts.postbuild: echo Build output is in client/dist — start server with npm start
